distracted-boyfriend.message: Use Distracted Boyfriend when someone who was satisfied with an existing choice suddenly notices a tempting new alternative.
distracted-boyfriend.relational_pattern: A person shifts attention from a current commitment toward a more exciting option while the neglected choice looks on.
distracted-boyfriend.example_context: I was perfectly happy with my current phone until I saw the shiny new model.
distracted-boyfriend.near_miss_context: Avoid when someone is choosing between two options for the first time and has no existing commitment to neglect.

success-kid.message: Use Success Kid to celebrate a small but satisfying victory, especially when the outcome beat expectations.
success-kid.relational_pattern: A person gets an unexpectedly favorable result and responds with a compact, triumphant fist-pump.
success-kid.example_context: I guessed on the final question and it was the one answer that pushed me over the passing grade.
success-kid.near_miss_context: Avoid when the achievement is solemn, routine, or belongs to someone who is disappointed by the result.

success-kid-original.message: Use Success Kid Original to celebrate a small but satisfying victory that worked out better than expected.
success-kid-original.relational_pattern: A person gets an unexpectedly favorable result and answers it with a determined, triumphant fist-pump.
success-kid-original.example_context: I found the last open seat on the train just as the doors closed behind me.
success-kid-original.near_miss_context: Avoid when the result is routine, solemn, or disappointing rather than a compact personal win.

disaster-girl.message: Use Disaster Girl when someone caused, anticipated, or quietly enjoys the chaos unfolding behind them.
disaster-girl.relational_pattern: A suspiciously calm observer watches the consequences of a disaster with a knowing, satisfied expression.
disaster-girl.example_context: I changed one production setting, watched every alert turn red, and tried not to look pleased with the chaos I caused.
disaster-girl.near_miss_context: Avoid when the person is frightened by the crisis, trying to stop it, or has no implied connection to the trouble.

always-has-been.message: Use Always Has Been when someone discovers that a supposedly new truth, pattern, or problem was there all along.
always-has-been.relational_pattern: One person voices a surprising realization, and another confirms that the hidden reality has always been true.
always-has-been.example_context: I finally realized every urgent meeting is just the same status update with a different title.
always-has-been.near_miss_context: Avoid when the situation genuinely changed recently rather than revealing a long-standing truth.

255177692-astronaut-meme-always-has-been.name: Astronaut Always Has Been
255177692-astronaut-meme-always-has-been.message: Use Astronaut Always Has Been when a supposedly new discovery reveals a truth or problem that existed all along.
255177692-astronaut-meme-always-has-been.relational_pattern: One observer voices a shocking realization, and another confirms that the hidden reality was never new.
255177692-astronaut-meme-always-has-been.example_context: I just noticed that every optional team event has quietly been mandatory the whole time.
255177692-astronaut-meme-always-has-been.near_miss_context: Avoid when the situation truly began recently or the point is uncertainty rather than an established hidden truth.

bad-luck-brian.message: Use Bad Luck Brian when careful preparation or hopeful effort is ruined by a specifically unlucky and embarrassing twist.
bad-luck-brian.relational_pattern: Someone does the sensible thing or expects an ordinary outcome, but improbable bad luck turns it into failure.
bad-luck-brian.example_context: I backed up my presentation twice, and both drives failed five minutes before the meeting.
bad-luck-brian.near_miss_context: Avoid when the failure was predictable, caused by obvious negligence, or merely disappointing without an unlucky reversal.

original-bad-luck-brian.message: Use Original Bad Luck Brian when reasonable preparation or hopeful effort is defeated by a specifically unlucky and embarrassing twist.
original-bad-luck-brian.relational_pattern: Someone expects an ordinary outcome, but improbable bad luck turns the attempt into a memorable failure.
original-bad-luck-brian.example_context: I arrived early for the interview, and the building lost power only for the hour I was there.
original-bad-luck-brian.near_miss_context: Avoid when the failure was predictable, caused by obvious negligence, or lacks an unlucky reversal.
